verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Shopify exposing UCP/MCP servers and a CLI so that external AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) can query catalog/cart/checkout/order data — i.e., Shopify as the server being consumed by outside assistants, not Shopify shipping its own built-in AI assistant that a user delegates tasks to inside the product. No mention of an embedded Shopify-native assistant (e.g., a merchant/shopper copilot) appears anywhere in the pack.
